text:
DeployBot: initiating staged rollout for inference-api model=v2.6.0 cohort=APAC initial=4% planned-bump=12% at +8m. `/deploy start --staged=4% --model=v2.6.0`
Iris: heads-up: this build has a tokenizer pivot and a latency micro-optim that touched KV-cache logic. Watch token_count and kvcache.hitrate.
Diego: can we pin to driver-stable nodes for the canary? Saw a warmstart drift on those nodes last week.
InfraTeam: pin applied to driver-stable pool; hotstart-throttle=6s.
Maya (oncall): holding until auth and p99 look stable for 5m. If auth.fail.delta >0.4% or p99 + >100ms, call stop.
DeployBot: canary live at 4%. Monitoring hooks: auth.fail, latency.p99, tokenizer.token_count.delta, kvcache.hitrate.
NotesBot: auto-add release-note draft: "v2.6.0 includes tokenizer pivot and KV-cache tweak; staged canary APAC."
Telemetry: tokenizer.token_count.delta = +2.1% (warn 2.0%) at 19:07:12 UTC. kvcache.hitrate = -1.2%.
Iris: token_count nudged over warn; kvcache dip small. Recommend hold at 4% soak 8m.
Maya (oncall): holding. Auth and p99 within thresholds so far.
Diego: running quick smoke against long multi-turn flows; no immediate truncation issues.
DeployBot: proposing bump to 12% after soak. Vote: :thumbsup: to bump, :thumbsdown: to stop.
Iris: :thumbsup:
Diego: :thumbsup:
Maya (oncall): :thumbsdown: still want 2 more minutes on p99 tail.
DeployBot: bump postponed. Continuing soak.
Telemetry: after +3m soak tokenizer.token_count.delta = +3.4% (alert threshold 3.0%), kvcache.hitrate = -3.8%, latency.p99 +130ms.
Maya (oncall): calling stop. p99 exceeded, kvcache hit dip could affect latency further. Stop and rollback to v2.5.3.
Iris: agree, stop. Trigger rollback.
DeployBot: rollback initiated `/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.5.3`
InfraTeam: scaling v2.6.0 down, reinstating v2.5.3. Expect warmstart bleed ~75s.
NotesBot: update release notes: "v2.6.0 APAC staged halted at 4% due to tokenizer and kvcache regressions impacting p99; rolled back to v2.5.3. Action: revert KV-cache micro-opt, run extended kvcache soak, and re-evaluate tokenizer pivot in isolated staging."
Maya (oncall): I'll open a follow-up incident for the p99 tail and tag infra + runtime.
Diego: I'll prepare a reduced diff PR isolating tokenizer change for separate validation.
Iris: adding quick rollback runbook snippet to thread:
```
/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.5.3
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-api -w
```
DeployBot: automation closing thread after rollback completes. Reopen if post-rollback telemetry shows anomalies.
